rules.title: Rent Increase Disclosure Requirement
rules.requirement: If a landlord raises rent more than 10% upon lease renewal for an existing tenant, the landlord must disclose an itemization of costs, whether a rent algorithm was used, the tenant's right to legal action, and Division of Housing contact information.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential landlords increasing rent by more than 10% upon lease renewal with a current tenant year over year.
rules.quoted_span: All residential landlords seeking to increase rent by more than 10% upon a renewal of a lease with a current tenant year over year shall be required to make the following disclosures to existing tenants either in the lease upon renewal (must be clearly indicated on the first page) or on a form provided by the Hoboken Division of Housing prior to the increase being implemented
rules.conflict_note: This is a disclosure requirement triggered by a 10% rent increase threshold, not a cap on the increase itself; categorized under rent_increase_limits as closest fit.

rules.title: Ban on Algorithmic Price Fixing for Residential Rentals
rules.requirement: Landlords renting residential dwelling units in Hoboken are prohibited from using software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to collect and analyze nonpublic competitor information in order to coordinate, recommend, or implement rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels among competing landlords.
rules.key_value: Prohibition on algorithmic price fixing using nonpublic competitor data
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords renting any residential dwelling unit (primary residence) in the City of Hoboken, excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities.
rules.exemptions: Medical/long-term care or detention facilities are excluded from the definition of residential dwelling unit.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
